benchmark_flash_attention: benchmark flash attention forward and backward pass across Flash2, Flash3, Triton, and CuDNN implementations
time_forward_pass: time the forward pass of an attention function using do_bench with configurable repeats and warmup iterations
calculate_attention_flops: calculate the FLOPs for a self-attention operation given batch, heads, sequence lengths, and head dimensions
setup_cudnn_sdpa: setup a cuDNN SDPA graph for forward and backward execution with causal masking and sliding window support
convert_torch_to_cudnn_type: convert a PyTorch dtype to the corresponding cuDNN data type enum value
